name: Maya Chen
resumeText:
Maya Chen
Senior full-stack engineer

Pulseboard (Feb 2023 – Oct 2026)
Built a real-time operations dashboard used by an on-call rotation. The browser subscribes over websockets, and a TypeScript ingest pipeline pulls events from the source systems, retries failed batches, and writes the rows the board reads. I owned the protocol, the pipeline, and the React UI. The repository includes end-to-end tests around the socket protocol and a build that runs in CI.

Before that I worked on internal admin tools. Pulseboard is the project I want judged.
